metadata.summary: Gaurav ordered a hot latte with a medium size and no nuts.

messages.text: Hello Gaurav, Welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It is great to see you again. How can I help you today?
Can I order a half latte?
I found a few options for you. We have a Hot Latte, an Iced Latte, and an Iced Lavender Blackberry Oat Milk Latte. Which one of these options sounds good to you?
Your Hot Latte with a medium size, 16 ounces, will be $4.49. Would you like to pay with cash or card today?
I hope you are still with me!

I've noted that you would like no nuts. Your total comes out to be $4.49. I just need to confirm your order. You've ordered a Hot Latte, with a medium size, 16 ounces, and no nuts, correct? Also, do you have any other special requests or allergies I should know about?
